Your device sends radio waves through the air to a router - that's your lighthouse beacon - which catches those signals and forwards them along the great network ocean to their destination. The router speaks to multiple devices at once, much like a harbor master coordinating ships coming and going, using different radio frequencies so the signals don't crash into each other like vessels in a fog.
